parts.problem_md:
$c=5a-2b$

i) Find the value of $c$ when $a$ = 8 and $b$ = −3.

[2]

ii) Make $a$ the subject of the formula $c=5a-2b$.

$a$ = ................................................... [2]
parts.solution_md:
> *i) Substitute in the values*

$c = 5 \times ( 8 ) - 2 \times ( - 3 )$

**[1]**

> *Using the correct order of operations, do the multiplication first*

$c = 40 - ( - 6 )$

> *Subtracting a negative is the same as adding the positive version*

$c=40+6=46$

**46** **[1]**

> *ii) To make **a** the subject, start by adding 2**b** to each side*

$c+2b=5a$

**[1]**

> *Then divide by 5 to get **a** on its own*

$\frac{c+2b}{5}=a$

$a=\frac{c+2b}{5}$* ***[1]**
